wins.label: EPYC Adoption Acceleration
wins.evidence: Adoption of 5th Gen EPYC Turin processors accelerated rapidly, accounting for nearly half of overall EPYC revenue in the quarter.

wins.label: AI Business Momentum
wins.evidence: Our data center AI business is entering its next phase of growth with customer momentum building rapidly.

wins.label: Strategic Partnerships

risks.label: Component Availability

risks.label: Power and Infrastructure Constraints
risks.evidence: Power requirements for early announcements into next year are substantial, and infrastructure may be a gating factor.

wins.label: Record Revenue & Profitability
wins.evidence: Revenue grew 36% year-over-year to $9.2 billion. Net income rose 31%, and free cash flow more than tripled

wins.label: Strong Data Center Demand
wins.evidence: Data center segment revenue increased 22% year-over-year to a record $4.3 billion led by the ramp of our Instinct MI350 Series GPUs and server share gains.

wins.label: EPYC CPU Dominance
wins.evidence: Server CPU revenue reached an all-time high as adoption of 5th Gen EPYC Turin processors accelerated rapidly, accounting for nearly half of overall EPYC revenue in the quarter.

wins.label: Hyperscaler Adoption of EPYC
wins.evidence: Hyperscalers launched more than 160 EPYC-powered instances in the quarter, including new Turin offerings from Google, Microsoft Azure, Alibaba and others.

wins.label: ROCm 7 Performance Boost
wins.evidence: ROCm 7, our most advanced release to date, delivering up to 4.6x higher inference and 3x higher training performance compared to ROCm 6.

risks.label: Supply Chain Constraints
risks.evidence: Multiple cloud and AI providers are ramping up MI350 Series GPU deployments, with additional large-scale rollouts on track to ramp over the coming quarters.

risks.label: Competition in AI Market
risks.evidence: OpenAI's decision to use AMD Instinct GPUs for its most sophisticated AI workloads sends a clear signal that our Instinct GPUs and ROCm open software stack deliver the performance and TCO required for the most demanding deployments.

risks.label: MI308 Shipment Restrictions
risks.evidence: Revenue increased 20% sequentially driven by strong growth in the data center, and client and gaming segment and modest growth in the embedded segment. Before I review the balance sheet and the cash flow, as a reminder, we closed the sale of ZT System manufacturing business to Sanmina last week.

risks.label: Complexity of Helios Rack
risks.evidence: Development of both our MI400 Series GPUs and Helios rack is progressing rapidly, supported by deep technical engagements across a growing set of hyperscalers, AI companies and OEM and ODM partners to enable large-scale deployments next year.
